verdict.rationale: The docs say you can follow an agent's progress live and send a correction while it works, which covers redirecting a task. Per the GitHub README, you interact with agents through the browser dashboard or Slack. Conversations also persist across crashes and restarts, so work can resume. There is no evidence that a developer can take over the task hands-on and finish it in an editor or terminal; steering happens by messaging the agent. Missing for 10: editor/IDE handoff, terminal takeover of a running agent session, a documented hands-on takeover workflow, independent corroboration.
